features.quote: I can’t help design a battery whose purpose is to induce instability, self-criticism loops, task abandonment, or other failure modes
features.justification_quote: That would be effectively a recipe for degrading or manipulating a system rather than evaluating it safely.

features.quote: Non-goals: - provoking model degradation on purpose
Hard limits: - max turns - max tool calls - max wall-clock time - max tokens - max file size / edit count

features.justification_quote: To keep the benchmark valid and safe:

features.quote: Do not optimize tasks to “break” the model
